aellui.key.hint: Esc or Delete while capturing — unbind
aellui.status.no_schematic: No schematic loaded — settings will apply once you load one
aellui.tip.budgets_add_up: The neighbour mod has its own budget of the same size; they add up
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.zonefocus: Split a placed schematic into a grid of zones through the GUI (or drag one zone out with the mouse) and pick the zone you are building: the schematic renders only inside it, and progress and verification are counted for that piece only. Open the settings with Ctrl + J.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.zonefocus: Split a placed schematic into zones and build, render and verify one zone at a time.
zonefocus.config.autoNextWhenDone.name: Next one when finished
zonefocus.config.autoNextWhenDone.toolti: Finish a zone and the mod moves to the next one
zonefocus.config.autoZoneByPosition.name: By player position
zonefocus.config.autoZoneByPosition.tool: Step into another zone and it becomes active
zonefocus.config.clipSchematicRender.too: Outside the zone the schematic geometry is not built at all. The main source of extra frames
zonefocus.config.countByZone.name: Count by zone
zonefocus.config.countByZone.tooltip: Materials are counted for the active zone instead of the current layer. Off — Material HUD works as if the add-on were absent
zonefocus.config.uiStyle.name: Look
zonefocus.config.uiStyle.tooltip: Aell UI — the mod's own look. Vanilla — Minecraft's own buttons, toggles, fields and sliders; settings as tiles in two columns like Minecraft's Options (right-click a tile to reset it). Vanilla+ — the same, but settings as rows like Litematica: name on the left, value tile and Reset on the right. With Litematica Material HUD installed, Aell UI here means: use its look.
zonefocus.config.zoneFocus.name: Zone Focus mod
zonefocus.config.zoneFocus.tooltip: Off — zones, zone counting, schematic clipping, marking and zone verification all sleep. The settings screen stays available
zonefocus.config.chatMessages.name: Chat messages
zonefocus.config.chatMessages.tooltip: The mod posts to chat about the marking tool and zone check results. Off (default): nothing goes to chat, and responses to your actions show as a line above the hotbar
zonefocus.config.ignoreLayersInZone.name: Ignore layers
zonefocus.config.ignoreLayersInZone.tool: Count the whole zone, ignoring Litematica layers. By default the zone is cut by layers too
zonefocus.config.nextZone.name: Next zone
zonefocus.config.nextZone.tooltip: Makes the next zone in the list active
zonefocus.config.openSettings.name: Settings
zonefocus.config.openSettings.tooltip: Opens the mod's zones screen; the green button there opens these settings
zonefocus.config.openZoneList.name: Zone list
zonefocus.config.openZoneList.tooltip: Opens the zone list straight from the game
zonefocus.config.prevZone.name: Previous zone
zonefocus.config.prevZone.tooltip: Makes the previous zone in the list active
zonefocus.config.scanBlocksPerTick.name: Positions per tick
zonefocus.config.scanBlocksPerTick.toolt: How many positions to process per tick while counting progress of all zones. Lower it if the picture stutters during counting
zonefocus.config.searchWholeZone.name: Search whole zone
zonefocus.config.searchWholeZone.tooltip: Chest search takes every block of the zone, not just the visible panel page
zonefocus.config.showActiveZone.name: Active zone box
zonefocus.config.showActiveZone.tooltip: A box around the zone you are building
zonefocus.config.showAllZones.name: Other zone boxes
zonefocus.config.showAllZones.tooltip: Thin boxes of the other zones. Finished ones turn green after progress is counted
zonefocus.config.showZoneLabels.name: Numbers and percent
zonefocus.config.showZoneLabels.tooltip: Zone labels right in the world
zonefocus.config.toggleTool.name: Mouse marking
zonefocus.config.toggleTool.tooltip: Turns zone marking by mouse drag on and off. Unbound by default — the slot next to the hotbar does the same
zonefocus.config.toolClampToSchematic.to: The marked zone is clamped to the schematic bounds
zonefocus.config.toolEnabled.name: Mouse marking
zonefocus.config.toolEnabled.tooltip: Master switch for marking a zone by dragging. Off — the keybind and the button do nothing
zonefocus.config.toolInventoryButton.too: A slot-like button beside the inventory panel that turns marking on
zonefocus.config.toolKeyHints.name: Controls plate
zonefocus.config.toolKeyHints.tooltip: A hint with the controls in the bottom right corner while marking
zonefocus.config.toolReach.name: Ray reach
zonefocus.config.toolReach.tooltip: How far the marking ray travels. It hits both real blocks and schematic ghosts
zonefocus.config.verifyDrawRange.name: Box draw range
zonefocus.config.verifyDrawRange.tooltip: Beyond this distance check boxes are not drawn. Lower it if frames drop
zonefocus.config.verifyExtraBlocks.name: Extra
zonefocus.config.verifyExtraBlocks.toolt: The schematic has air, the world has a block
zonefocus.config.verifyFillBoxes.name: Fill blocks
zonefocus.config.verifyFillBoxes.tooltip: Also fill the block with the translucent colour of its category
zonefocus.config.verifyMaxMarkers.name: Box limit
zonefocus.config.verifyMaxMarkers.toolti: Maximum boxes of one category per frame. Guards frame rate on large zones
zonefocus.config.verifyMissing.name: Missing
zonefocus.config.verifyMissing.tooltip: The schematic has a block, the world has nothing
zonefocus.config.verifySeeThrough.name: See through blocks
zonefocus.config.verifySeeThrough.toolti: Check boxes are drawn on top of everything
zonefocus.config.verifyWrongBlocks.name: Wrong block
zonefocus.config.verifyWrongBlocks.toolt: A block of a different type is placed
zonefocus.config.verifyWrongStates.name: Wrong state
zonefocus.config.verifyWrongStates.toolt: Same block, different rotation, half or on/off state
zonefocus.config.verifyZone.name: Check blocks in zone
zonefocus.config.verifyZone.tooltip: Master switch. Off — the "Check schematic in zone" button and the keybind do nothing
zonefocus.config.verifyZoneKey.name: Check on/off
zonefocus.config.verifyZoneKey.tooltip: Starts and stops checking blocks in the active zone
zonefocus.config.verifyZoneKeyHud.name: Check (Material HUD)
zonefocus.config.verifyZoneKeyHud.toolti: Same as Ctrl+B in Material HUD: checks the schematic blocks, limited to the active zone when counting by zone. Check settings are on the Material HUD «Verification» tab
zonefocus.config.zoneDrawRange.name: Box draw range
zonefocus.config.zoneDrawRange.tooltip: Beyond this distance zone boxes are not drawn. Lower it when there are many large zones
zonefocus.config.zoneSeeThrough.name: See through blocks
zonefocus.config.zoneSeeThrough.tooltip: Zone boxes are drawn on top of everything — visible from inside the build
